name: GOV extended: AssetSourceUpdated (Aave V3 AaveOracle)
description: Aave V3 AaveOracle: AssetSourceUpdated(address,address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
